title-idle.about: Load, sit on the splash (no input) for 6 s.

camp-walk.about: Splash, title (Enter on Play - Male), then walk the Placeholdia camp in a square.

camp-zoom.about: Hub ground look at camera zoom 1, 2 and 4 with render scale pinned at 1.0 (?wdb-no-dynres; window.wdbZoom). Shots only; run with --width 1920 --height 1080.

camp-idle.about: Camp, stand still with no UI for 4 s: the reference for camp-pause and camp-shop (what the menus add on top of the 3D town).

hub-load.about: Engine load marks only: boots straight into Play (?wdb-load-timing-smoke), prints the Title to Placeholdia breakdown (preload, camp_light, camp build, warmup) as load lines. Frame stats are not meaningful.

dungeon-load.about: Engine load marks only: Placeholdia to dungeon floor 1 seed 42 (?wdb-dungeon-load-timing-smoke): music_play, gen, visuals, light, warm-up as load lines with wasm memory. Frame stats are not meaningful.

camp-pause.about: Camp, open the pause menu (Escape), sit 4 s, close.

camp-shop.about: Camp, walk to the vendor stall, open the shop (E), sit 4 s, leave.

dungeon-walk.about: Camp, floor crystal loadout (E), Enter dungeon (floor 1, seed 42), walk the entrance room in a square. _enter holds the scene-change hitch and dungeon_load_ms.

dungeon-music-cold.about: Regression for web dungeon music: cold cache, 8 Mbit/s network, Enter dungeon (floor 1, seed 42), then 25 s walking with the CPU throttled 4x (forced low fps). An audio-thread probe counts silent gaps after the music starts. Asserts no gaps and frame p95 under 150 ms in the music phase, uncapped (~65-70 ms on the box; fails the run).

dungeon-arrive.about: Camp, then the player's own dungeon entry (window.wdbEnter: cover, load, reveal; seed 42), then stand 4 s after the cover lifts: what the player sees on arrival.

dungeon-fight.about: Camp, then the debug playtester (window.wdbPlaytest, ?wdb-playtest) runs one fresh Great Axe AI run on floor 1 with seed 42 (?wdb-seed=42) for 30 s of sim time, then 6 s without it (phase _after, a rough no-playtester reference). fps includes playtester overhead: compare only with itself. play_runs lists each run's kills/damage so repeatability is visible.

bug-dry.about: Camp, then one Report Bug dry run through the live relay (window.wdbBugDry; dry_run stores nothing, counts toward the 10/h IP limit); prints the relay answer as a waitfor line.
